# Catanel

> Catanel is a free, browser-based random board generator and dice roller for the board game Catan (Settlers of Catan).

- 3–4 players: generates a standard 19-hex map with 4 wood, 4 wool, 4 wheat, 3 clay (brick), 3 iron (ore) and 1 desert.
- 5–6 players: generates the 30-hex extension map with 6 wood, 6 wool, 6 wheat, 5 clay, 5 iron, 2 deserts and 28 number tokens.
- Balanced mode (default): equal numbers, 6 & 8, and 2 & 12 are never adjacent; no 3+ same-resource tiles clump together; every resource gets a fair share of the high-probability numbers.
- Random mode: plain shuffle that only keeps 6 and 8 apart (the official setup rule).
- The robber starts on the desert.
- Built-in two-dice roller shows the total, flags a 7 (robber moves), highlights tiles matching the roll, can be cleared to see the plain map, and keeps the last 6 rolls.
- "New map" reshuffles the board instantly. No sign-up, no install, works on mobile.

## Pages

- [Catanel app](https://catanel.odajiu.eu/): the board generator and dice roller (single-page app)
